items.name: Purrfect Choice
items.summary:
Once the most popular guy in high school, Lim Sang-Ho never expected to be attending college at 28. At a class reunion, he reconnects with Ko Yeong-Ha, the underclassman who used to follow him everywhere - and who has somehow grown into an annoyingly-handsome adult. Bonding over their shared status as late-blooming college students, the two quickly fall back into old habits. But while feeding stray cats after the reunion, Yeong-Ha drops a bombshell: his male boss seems to have a crush on him. Completely clueless about dating men, Yeong-Ha turns to the openly gay Sang-Ho for advice…and maybe a little hands-on instruction. Some choices are hard to make. Others? Well, they’re simply the cat’s meow!

(Source: Lezhin US)

A gambler. A failure. And now a divorcé after ending ten years of marriage. This is the life of Jung Cheol. With nothing going right, he barely has time to lament his misfortunes when the very person who started it all returns. items.name: Winterfield
items.summary:
At the far edge of a distant continent lies Oldenlandt, a land buried under eternal snow, ruled by Grand Duke Giesel Zvendard. With his cold demeanor, overwhelming magical prowess, and eerie rumors that monster blood runs through his veins, he is feared by all. Yet few know that what Giesel truly desires is a quiet life spent immersed in magical research, enjoying a warm cup of tea in a silent study. That modest wish is shattered by an unexpected bride from the southern frontier of Cornia.

In place of his runaway younger sister, the one who appears wearing the bridal wreath is Rensley Mallosen, an illegitimate son of Cornia. After briefly hiding to avoid exposing his identity, this bright and talkative knight, golden hair shining like sunlight, begins roaming freely through the castle, stirring small disturbances in what once seemed like an eternally silent ice fortress. Though casting him out for a fraudulent marriage would have been more than justified, Giesel finds himself unable to look away from Rensley, who smiles radiantly and chatters away even at the smallest kindness.

Rejected from birth and ultimately cast aside, Rensley came to Oldenlandt with nowhere else to go. Faced with Giesel's quiet yet gentle care, he begins to harbor feelings of affection. But just as he becomes aware of his heart, the moment of parting draws near.

To the coldest land on the continent, yet the one filled with the warmest things of all, will Rensley be able to return to Oldenlandt once more?

Little A travels to a rural farm to reunite with the uncle who raised him—only to find the place eerily silent and his uncle nowhere in sight. What awaits him is a chilling "bible" detailing how to care for the livestock… but something feels off.

Because on this farm, the "livestock" aren’t animals—they’re humans.

Now thrust into the role of acting farm manager, little A is forced to manage Mr. A’s Farm, a facility that produces livestock products using beast-like humans—creatures who think and act like people, but are bred for their byproducts.

Dark secrets plague the estate in the uncle’s absence. Little A must do all he can to keep the farm safe and sound...at least until his missing uncle, Mr.A, comes back.

Yet, a mysterious young man unexpectedly appears, requesting to learn about adult love. His genuine vulnerability starts to evoke feelings within Na Hae-soo, prompting her to rethink her future.

Once, romance, flowers, and dates perfectly encapsulated the relationship between Haesu and Mincheol. Now, all that remains for Haesu are the remnants of their marriage and a towering amount of debt. However, her life completely fractures when Mincheol has an affair with a young coworker. In her pain and sense of betrayal, Haesu finds herself increasingly attracted to Taeha, a young man who appears to long for her love… and may be concealing more than he reveals.

"I must see my grandchild," his father states, making it a requirement for succession to have a child. It seems ridiculous, doesn't it? Under his father's pressure, Omega Yuhyun starts searching for a husband. Amidst numerous plots surrounding Yuhyun, Hyundo, his childhood friend and the second-in-command who eyes the boss's position, hears the news. "Whose child are you planning to have if not mine?" he questions. This sets off a perilous relationship between Yuhyun, who is determined to retain the boss's role, and Alpha Hyundo, who wishes to possess him. A succession battle ignites based on the need for an heir. Caught between desire, obsession, and love, what choice will Yuhyun ultimately make...?

items.summary:
*“He was a man exhausted. Exhausted by the very essence of boredom.”*  
Kwon Taeshin, a VIP patron at the elite members-only establishment Zeus, was known for purchasing a night with someone—but never the same individual on two occasions. One day, Lee Wonwoo, a young man employed part-time at the club to support his family, finds himself driving Taeshin’s vehicle as a valet. Unexpectedly, Taeshin playfully suggests buying a night with him.  
*“Have you ever been with a man before?”*  
With a plain appearance and an average demeanor, Wonwoo is taken aback to be selected, yet the substantial amount offered lures him into agreeing to the deal.  
*“You’ll pay me in advance, right?”*  
Following a difficult and regrettable night, Wonwoo resolves to steer clear of Taeshin completely. Yet Taeshin becomes more and more captivated by him.  
*“I thought it over thoroughly... and I believe I want to spend the night with you again.”*

Jaheon comes from a lineage of omegas. Omegas who have raised the children of their branch families, only for them to be offered to the Snake God, Lord Mugo, every 12 years. Though it is said that Mugo handpicks his sacrifices no one in the head family believes such an old tale anymore. However, Jaheon knows that Lord Mugo came to him when he was a child and picked him to be the sacrifice, and even remembers the events of the day. Even though Jaheon has prepared himself, both body and mind, for as long as he could remember, upon entering Mugo's lair he quickly realizes that he doesn't want to be eaten as a sacrifice, at least not after finding out the "Lord Mugo" he adored was just one of the snake god's three personalities. Will the Snake God take pity on his sacrifice? Or will Jaheon be swallowed whole?
